race.comment: OVER THE LOUVRE (3) gets the nod after a much sharper Gold Coast effort, leading until late and finishing fifth, beaten just over a length, despite being unwanted in the market. He is race fit, rated strongly on recent form and looks well placed coming back from provincial company. TO'O (10) is the main danger after a Ballina second, and the Lismore fourth before that was only a length away after early trouble, so his form is building. LEGAS SPIRIT (12) debut fourth at Kilcoy was sound and she now comes out of a heavier Eagle Farm assignment into an easier meeting. COME SUNDOWN (7) was safely held at Ipswich, yet he did pick up from well back and had earlier run second as a well-supported favourite at Gympie. Has enough upside to be in the mix. CINCINNATI COBRA (6) makes plenty of appeal third-up.
